notes.title: 5 Years - 10 000 Downloads
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today marks five years since I released my first project on Steam — a story I began creating when I was 17. It will always remain special as my first experience in writing and drawing my own story. Today also marks the major milestone of reaching over 10 000 downloads. So for everyone who has played and enjoyed Tyrania, I thank you very much and I hope to see you again in my next upcoming story.

Speaking of next story, I haven't posted much news on Steam for a while, but I've been silently working on my next project + university at the same time. More news will come during this year and/or at the beginning of 2026 ;)

Thank you everyone
- Leviathanimation

notes.title: Thank you for 9000 downloads + Tyrania Enforcers update (and delay)!!!
notes.content:
Howdy y'all

I'm super grateful for more than 9000 downloads! I've been reading reviews since the beginning and I'm trying to improve myself for my future projects as much as I can. Being a French Canadian, English isn't my first language, plus I'm primarily working on my own so it's hard to find and fix all the little mistakes ;O

Now moving on to my second work-in-progress Visual Novel...
Itch.io doesn't allow me to publish game files larger than 1 GB, so I'm now posting all future updates on [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/tyrania-enfocers/531084]Gamejolt[/url] (Chapters 1 to 4 are now available).

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/116ab1ed-5856-4f2d-bfd0-50dd7a7ef16e/dfc5jko-0bad23ec-3920-444c-a883-81f996a8bc27.png/v1/fill/w_1280,h_720,q_80,strp/char_by_leviathanimation_dfc5jko-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..yfxXOS1bEWrat4XUfpWrRHPCWf5-jyifi_Dmt8ksjvU[/img]
[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/116ab1ed-5856-4f2d-bfd0-50dd7a7ef16e/dfc5k6p-0ac87e1b-3f9d-4d06-9d05-7e18f1af84b6.png/v1/fill/w_1280,h_727,q_80,strp/tap_by_leviathanimation_dfc5k6p-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ENaT227abiHbNb0AWTO6gG2GJ2ef6snNr5-un5_7D4M[/img]

With that being said, Tyrania Enforcers is MUCH more complicated than my first project in terms of animations and overall visuals. I'll therefore have to delay the release for an unknown amount of time to be able to improve as much as possible on the overall quality of my next project. I really do prefer to work longer to better the quality rather than cutting corners for a faster release... And working on animations alone is really, REALLY long...

For those who don't follow me on Twitter or Youtube, here's a little peek of the animations for Tyrania Enforcers:
[previewyoutube=NdflEXcRA7o;full][/previewyoutube]


Once again, thank you all for over 9000 downloads!!! :D
- Leviathanimation

notes.title: One Year
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=PWmyMHUr8t8;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello there!

It's been a full year since the release back in 2020! I would like to thank all of you who played Tyrania! Now here is a short teaser of my next project! This will be my first summer entirely dedicated to working on my next visual novel (from May till August). Hopefully, I will be able to finish at least half of it before school starts again...


Besides the progress on my next project, there will be a small patch soon to fix the german script by my translator Tomass Kirsch.

notes.content:

This is my largest update so far, and it also includes some other artwork changes. I'll do another update/patch for New Year and after that, I'll fully be focused on Tyrania II. Tyrania II (or Tyrania Enforcers) will also be translated into other languages like [i][b]French, Spanish, Latvian[/b][/i], etc. If any of you would like to help with translating in another language, you can message here and we'll talk about it, but I only take volunteers because I'm a broke university student lol.

notes.title: The Tyranian Saga Continues!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37756140/a2044ee8dcc44ddf74b57d93acece1a341fb3437.png[/img]

Hello there!

I am happy to announce that I just released a short demo prologue for my next project: [b]Tyrania Enforcers! [/b]Now hold up, there are a few things everyone should know first. This is just a short demo for the prologue, just to introduce the direction the story will continue on and to introduce the new characters.
The story will be from the perspective of an average civilian plus 2 soldiers and the events happen at the same time during the war in Tyrania. I added new features such as a[b] dynamic menu, blinking eyes, translations[/b] and more!



[b]Installation and Instructions[/b]

Tyrania Enforcers will eventually go to Steam when it is complete, but for a short prologue demo, I uploaded a zip file. You can find it on the itch.io page but in short:
[olist]
[*]Go to the itch.io page: [url=leviathanimation.itch.io/tyrania-enforcers.]Tyrania Enforcers[/url]
[*]Locate the download button and download the zip file.
[*]Extract the zip file.
[*]Locate the application "[i]Tyrania_Enforcers[/i]" inside the folder and run it.
[*]Enjoy!
[/olist]
Also, you can change the language in preferences, then select french or english.



[b]Updates and Release[/b]

The full release on steam will be... in a very long time o;
I love making animations cutscenes of military battles and stuff, and that takes soooo long to make so I expect the completion to be around [b]2022 or 2023[/b]. And there is also university too...
So knowing the release might take some time, I wanted the second story to be independant. You don't need to read the first story of Tyrania to understand the second one so if any of you forget about certain details, no worries!

This will probably be the last update here on Steam since it isn't too relevant to talk about my next visual novel here on this one. If you want to follow my progress or just message me in private, you can check out my twitter, where I go by the same name.
twitter.com/EdoTyrania

notes.title: What's Coming Next
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the community hub on steam just reached more than [b]500 followers[/b] yay :D
It isn't much compared to other titles, but since this is my first game on steam, I think it is still awesome and so I would like to thank everyone for playing Tyrania :)

Now for what's to come in the future, I am planning out my next visual novel, set in the same world as Tyrania, but from the perspective of the soldiers and the civilians. The story is already planned out and right now I am working on the artwork assets. I will try to include more animated cutscenes and more drawings overall too. The artwork will be better than my first visual novel since I used some old drawings from like years ago, while my next game will only include newly drawn assets. 

However, it might take some time before I release anything because of university, and also because I like to include animations in my visual novels and that takes a lot of time to make considering I am doing all of this on my own... I hope I'll be able to release a short prologue demo in a few months, but the full release on steam will have to wait till next year at least. For now, I already made a couple of drawings, but I don't want to spoil too much until a proper demo can be released. 
So here is one of the main characters of my next project :)
